name: For Each Multi Stage
description: Runs another Omniscope project once per input record in up to three stages, each a separate run of its own blocks, with an optional stage before the loop; sets the project's parameters from each record first.
introductoryText:
Runs **another project** once per input record, like *For Each (Separate Workflows)*, but each pass can have up to **three stages**: separate workflow runs of different blocks, each started when the previous one has finished. An optional stage runs **once before the loop**.

Use stages when blocks must run in a set order but are not connected, for example: stage 1 builds and writes a file, stage 2 publishes or emails it.

**Setting up**

1. In the other project, create the project parameters and link them to the block options they should change.
2. Connect one record per pass here, with one field per parameter, and choose those fields under *Parameter fields*.
3. Give the other project's address, for example `http://127.0.0.1:24679/Folder/Project.iox/`, and the blocks of each stage. The user needs the *Workflow Execution via APIs* and *Project parameters access via APIs* permissions.

The **Passes** output lists each pass's parameter values and its result.

options.name: Iox_File_Url
options.title: Project address
options.description: The address of the project to run, ending in .iox. On the same server, the internal address such as http://127.0.0.1:24679/Folder/Project.iox/ avoids the public address and its certificate. A report or workflow address of the project is cut back to the project.

options.name: username
options.title: Username
options.description: Optional. For a server that asks for sign-in with a list of users: sent with basic authentication. Leave empty when no sign-in is needed.

options.name: password
options.title: Password
options.description: Optional. The password for the username.

options.name: Block_Names_Before
options.title: Blocks before the loop
options.description: Optional. Blocks to run once, before any parameter is set, separated by commas. Empty: no stage before the loop.

options.name: Refresh_From_Source_Before
options.title: Refresh from source (before the loop)
options.description: Reload the data from the sources when running the blocks before the loop.

options.name: Parameters
options.title: Parameter fields
options.description: Input fields named like parameters of the other project. Each record sets these parameters, then runs the stages.

options.name: Block_Names
options.title: Stage 1 blocks
options.description: Optional. Blocks to run first on each pass, separated by commas. Empty: the whole workflow.

options.name: Refresh_From_Source
options.title: Refresh from source (stage 1)
options.description: Reload the data from the sources in stage 1.

options.name: Block_Names2
options.title: Stage 2 blocks
options.description: Optional. Blocks to run on each pass once stage 1 has finished. Empty: no stage 2.

options.name: Refresh_From_Source2
options.title: Refresh from source (stage 2)
options.description: Reload the data from the sources in stage 2.

options.name: Block_Names3
options.title: Stage 3 blocks
options.description: Optional. Blocks to run on each pass once stage 2 has finished. Empty: no stage 3.

options.name: Refresh_From_Source3
options.title: Refresh from source (stage 3)
options.description: Reload the data from the sources in stage 3.

options.name: ignore_errors
options.title: Carry on after a failed pass
options.description: When a stage fails or is cancelled, skip the rest of that pass, record it in the Passes output and go on with the next record. Off: stop at the first failure.

options.name: busy_wait_minutes
options.title: Wait for a busy project (minutes)
options.description: If the project is already running when a run should start, or a run stays queued, wait up to this long before stopping with an error. Empty: 10.

blockOutputs.label: Passes
blockOutputs.tooltip: One record per pass: Pass number, the parameter values, Result (COMPLETED, FAILED or CANCELLED), the stage that failed, and the Job IDs of the stages.
